title.narrative: Level of meeting the standards of the EU member state

description.narrative: To establish a common baseline in assessment of progress of the candidate countries, the EU developed a tool to evaluate all candidate countries using a standardised methodology. The indicator shows the results of the legal approximation and relevant reforms assessed in annual Enlargement reports.

comment.narrative: On 30 October the European Commission published its annual enlargement report a comprehensive document assessing the situation in all candidate countries. The the value of indicator presents the calculated average of the assessment of all 33 negotiation chapters.
The final target value will not change until publication of the Enlargement report 2025.
